calls.thesis: Hit unjustifiably by rate fears despite accelerating fundamentals; investor-day guide 15-20% annual earnings compounding for 5 yrs; 4.5% yield growing ~15%/yr; 21x fwd P/E near public-market lows; one of the market's best risk/rewards.
calls.base: 4.5% starting yield + ~5.5% annual price compounding = ~10% long-term CAGR.
calls.bull: Dividend yield-on-cost doubles every 5 years (9%/18%/36% over 5/10/15 yrs) if compounding holds.
calls.bear: No formal bear case; caveat only: keeps adding 'if it remains in this range'; does not expect 30%+ annual returns.
calls.stated_price: No number; 'will continue to buy if it remains in this range'
